name: Connecticut
summary: Statutes: the official General Statutes on cga.ct.gov cannot be read by either route (the script fails TLS verification; the fetch tool reports ROBOTS_DISALLOWED on every cga.ct.gov page except one cached titles index), so Justia's 2025 Connecticut General Statutes (constructible per section, chapter learned from Justia's title page which shows section ranges) is the working fallback. Constitution: the Secretary of the State's Register and Manual page on portal.ct.gov (one ~113K-char page; script reads it whole). Court rules (Practice Book, Code of Evidence) are PDFs on www.jud.ct.gov, which fails TLS for the script and whose built URLs are gated for the fetch tool: reported only. Case law: jud.ct.gov advance-release archives (from July 2000) and Connecticut Law Journal / official-reports PDFs (Conn. from vol. 320, Conn. App. full volumes) are readable by the fetch tool but hrefs are not exposed, so per-opinion text is read on Justia (Supreme 1846-, Appellate 1983-). Cert denials appear as 'Orders' PDFs in the Law Journal (Conn. Reports pages). Regulations: eregulations.ct.gov is a JavaScript shell; Cornell LII serves RCSA sections per URL.

citation_map.notes: Connecticut has no public-domain/vendor-neutral case citation. Connecticut courts cite statutes as 'General Statutes § 52-577' (no 'Conn.'), regulations as 'Regs., Conn. State Agencies § X', rules as 'Practice Book § 10-30' and 'Conn. Code Evid. § 7-2'; Bluebook forms are 'Conn. Gen. Stat. § 52-577' and 'Conn. Agencies Regs. § X'. Bare 'General Statutes § N' routes here because the NN[a]-NNN[a] section shape plus 'General Statutes' is Connecticut usage; if another state's record uses bare 'General Statutes', resolve by context. Statute sections are title-section (52-577, 53a-54a, 22a-174); the chapter is NOT derivable from the section: use Justia's title page (shows chapter section ranges) or cga.ct.gov titles index. A '§§ 52-577 and 52-584' list or '§§ a to b' range is several sections: the regex takes the first. Practice Book sections are chapter-section (10-30, 61-10) and Code of Evidence sections are article-section (7-2); bare 'Code of Evidence § N-N' and bare 'P.A. NN-NN' are context_required (Illinois also uses 'P.A.'). Docket numbers 'SC 20748' / 'AC 46166' are context_required. Official reports pagination: Connecticut Law Journal / Conn. Reports and Conn. App. PDFs carry official page numbers; Justia and advance-release slip opinions do not (Justia shows '0 Conn. App. 1' placeholder). Cert dispositions: CT style is 'cert. denied, 352 Conn. 911 (2025)'; the Conn. volume makes it distinctive; a cert cite with only A.3d is context_required. CourtListener ids from memory, unverified.

sources.title: General Statutes of Connecticut (cga.ct.gov)
sources.publisher: Connecticut General Assembly, Legislative Commissioners' Office
sources.official_status_evidence: Titles index says the compilation was 'Prepared under the direction of the Legislative Commissioners' Office' (https://cga.ct.gov/Current/pub/titles.htm); no UELMA authentication statement was seen (only one page could be read).
sources.coverage: General Statutes revised to January 1, 2025, plus the 2026 Supplement (separate /2026/sup/ chapter pages holding only amended sections); prior revisions under /{year}/pub/. Also hosts the Constitution and Public Acts.

access.pattern_rules: chapter = chapter number as printed, lower-case letter suffix kept (chap_926, chap_735a); anchor sec_{section} (sec_52-577). Chapter is not derivable from the section: titles.htm shows chapter and section ranges per title; title_{title}.htm (title_01, title_52, title_19a) lists chapters. Supplement: /{year}/sup/chap_{chapter}.htm holds only sections amended since the last revision.
access.navigation: titles.htm (shows 'Chapters 1 to 15e', 'Secs. 1-1 to 1-500' per title) → title_{NN}.htm → chap_{NNN}.htm#sec_{section}; then check /{year}/sup/chap_{NNN}.htm for amendments after the revision date.

automation.robots_txt: robots.txt (as served by the same site at prdext3.cga.ct.gov, headed 'robots.txt for https://www.cga.ct.gov') disallows only /cgi-bin/, /asp/menu/, /html/, /images/, /js/ and similar; no rule covers /Current/pub/.
automation.notes: Script: 'TLS certificate chain does not verify' on both www.cga.ct.gov and cga.ct.gov. Fetch tool: ROBOTS_DISALLOWED on www.cga.ct.gov/Current/Pub/titles.htm, /Current/pub/title_12.htm, /2025/pub/chap_883.htm, robots.txt itself, and on cga.ct.gov/Current/pub/title_01.htm and title_52.htm; only cga.ct.gov/Current/pub/titles.htm returned content (twice). Built chap_926.htm was permission-gated. Server-node hostnames prdext2/prdext3.cga.ct.gov serve the same site and pass TLS, but no CGA page was found linking to them: not used (alternate-host rule).
